title: Laravel Loom Index
description: Canonical schema for the JSON index emitted by `php artisan loom:scan`.

schema_version.description: Version of this document shape, `MAJOR.MINOR`. Consumers key on this.

loom_version.description: Semver of the Loom package that wrote the file. Informational.

scanned_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp ending in `Z`. The only field that differs between two scans of identical source.

laravel_version.description: Laravel version detected in the scanned app.

stats.description: Count of entries per section; always mirrors the array sizes.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the app root, forward-slashed. Never absolute: a leading `/`, `\` or drive letter is rejected.

id.description: Canonical identifier; the FQCN for class events.

dispatched_from.description: Dispatch sites that fire this event. Filled by the cross-link pass.

handled_by.description: Listeners that handle this event, one entry per listener and method, sorted by `listener`, `method`. Filled by the cross-link pass from `listeners[].handles`; closure listeners are not included.

event.description: Eloquent hook name. `booting` and `booted` come only from `Event::listen('eloquent.booted: ...')` strings; observer methods match the other values.

handler.description: FQCN of the observer or `Event::listen` target.

file.description: Observer class file, or the file holding the `Event::listen` call.

line.description: Observer class line, or the `Event::listen` call line.

handled_by.description: Observers and `Event::listen` targets, sorted by handler and method, deduplicated. The shape differs from `events[].handled_by` because observers are not listeners.

modelEvent.description: Synthetic Eloquent model events from observer hooks and `Event::listen('eloquent.*')` strings. Emitted directly by the observer scanner; the cross-link pass does not regenerate them.

method.description: Handler method. `handle` when the registration names none (auto-discovery, a bare `Listener::class`); a `[Listener::class, 'foo']` tuple keeps its method.

handles.description: Events this listener handles, deduplicated by `event`, `method` and sorted by `event`, then `method`.

registration.description: How the listener was found: `subscriber` (a subscriber's `subscribe()` method, return-array or imperative form), `listen_array` (`$listen` in an `EventServiceProvider`), `event_listen_call` (`Event::listen()` in a provider), `auto_discovered` (typed `handle()` parameter). When several paths find the same listener the order is `subscriber`, `listen_array`, `event_listen_call`, `auto_discovered`.

queued.description: `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface. A trait cannot confer it.

dispatches.description: Events and jobs dispatched from the listener's handler methods. Filled by the cross-link pass.

listener.description: Listener classes. Handler methods include inherited ones.

hooks.description: Observable model events the observer has a method for, sorted.

dispatches.description: Dispatches made from the observer's hook methods. Filled by the cross-link pass.

observer.description: Observer classes. One observer registered against N models gives N entries; when a pair is found through both paths, `attribute` wins over `observe_call`.

queued.description: `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface. A trait cannot confer it.

dispatched_from.description: Dispatch sites whose resolved kind is `job` and whose target is this class. Filled by the cross-link pass.

dispatches.description: Dispatches made from the job's `handle` method. Filled by the cross-link pass.

queueConfig.description: Queue properties read from class property literals. A key is `null` when the class declares no such property (the framework default applies at runtime). The literal keeps its own type.

method.description: Origin of the dispatch: `Class::method` for code in a class method (a pass-through closure such as `DB::transaction(fn () => ...)` counts for the enclosing method), `VERB /uri` for a route closure, `Class::$dispatchesEvents[hook]` for a model's `$dispatchesEvents` entry.

mode.description: How the call form executes, omitted for plain forms whose outcome follows the target's `queued` flag. `sync`: `dispatchSync`, `dispatch_sync`, `dispatchNow`, `sendNow`, `notifyNow`. `after_response`: `dispatchAfterResponse`, `->afterResponse()` on a chain. `push`: `Queue::push/pushOn/later/laterOn/bulk`, `Mail::queue/onQueue/queueOn/later/laterOn`. The `ShouldQueue` flag and the `sync` driver are not evaluated.

overrides.description: Dispatch-time modifiers found at the call site. Omitted when none.

channels.description: Notification-only. The literal channel filter of `Notification::send($users, $n, $channels)` or `sendNow(...)`, which overrides the notification's `via()`. Lowercased names or channel-class FQCNs. Omitted when absent, empty or non-literal.

dispatchSite.description: One place where a class is dispatched, sent or notified from. Shared by every `dispatched_from`, `sent_from` and `notified_from` list.

delay.description: From `->delay(60)`, integer seconds only; `now()->addMinutes(5)` and variables leave it absent.

dispatchOverrides.description: Fluent modifiers resolved statically at the call site. Only keys that were found are present, and the object is omitted when none were. A non-literal argument leaves its key absent.

target.description: FQCN of the dispatched event or job.

kind.description: Whether the target is an event or a job.

confidence.description: Always `high` for statically resolved targets; `medium` and `low` are reserved.

dispatch.description: A resolved dispatch made from a class method or closure.

event.description: FQCN for `::class` registrations, the raw string for string-keyed ones.

file.description: File holding the closure, not the registration call.

end_line.description: 1-indexed last line of the closure; equals `line` for a one-line closure.

registration.description: `listen_array` (closure in `$listen`), `event_listen_call` (second argument of `Event::listen()`), `subscriber` (inside a subscriber's `subscribe()`, as a return-array value or an imperative `$events->listen()`).

queued.description: Always `false`; closure queue detection is not done.

dispatches.description: Dispatches attributed to the closure by source span. Filled by the cross-link pass.

closureListener.description: Closure and arrow-function listener registrations. They have no class name, so each site is one entry and none is joined into `events[].handled_by`. Not deduplicated. Dispatch sites inside `[line, end_line]` of the same file belong to it, including sites in nested closures.

kind.description: Decided by the root call. `command`: `->command()`, target is the signature string verbatim or the FQCN for a `::class` argument. `job`: `->job()`, target is the FQCN. `closure`: `->call()`, target is `null` for an inline closure and `Class::method` for a tuple or `Class@method` callable. `exec`: `->exec()`, target is the shell command.

target.description: Depends on `kind`; `null` for an inline closure.

arguments.description: `command` kind only, else `[]`. The literal parameters of `->command(Class::class, [...])`: plain items as the stringified value, keyed items as `key=value`, booleans as `true`/`false`; unresolvable items are skipped.

queue.description: `job` kind only: the second argument of `->job($job, $queue)`.

connection.description: `job` kind only: the third argument of `->job($job, $queue, $connection)`.

cron.description: Canonical five-field expression for every recognised frequency helper (`daily` is `0 0 * * *`; `cron()` is passed through verbatim). `null` when no recognised helper appears, its argument is a variable, or the last helper is unrecognised. The last frequency helper in a chain wins, as at runtime.

frequency.description: Sub-minute interval for `everySecond` and its six siblings, whose cron is `null`. `null` for every other entry. At most one of `cron` and `frequency` is set; the last helper wins.

without_overlapping_expires_at.description: Expiry minutes from `->withoutOverlapping($minutes)`. `null` without a literal argument; the framework default of 1440 is not invented.

constraints.description: Opaque labels for non-cron restrictions, sorted ascending: day of week (`weekdays`, `sundays`), time window (`between(8:00,17:00)`), conditions (`when(closure)`, `skip(closure)`), environments (`environments(production,staging)`). They sit beside `cron`, not inside it.

line.description: Line of the root call, not the trailing modifier.

scheduleEntry.description: Task scheduler entries, one per chain. Deduplicated on `file`, `line`, `kind`, `target`; kernel and bootstrap forms win over the facade form. A `job` target can be joined to `jobs[].fqcn` client-side; there is no back-pointer.

uri.description: Route URI with enclosing group prefixes applied; always starts with `/`, the root is `/`.

name.description: Group name prefix concatenated as-is with the route's own `->name()`; `null` when unnamed.

middleware.description: Names as written, including those inherited from enclosing groups. Aliases and groups are not expanded. Source order.

end_line.description: Last line of a closure action. Present only for closure actions.

dispatches.description: Dispatches from the controller method, or for a closure route those within `[line, end_line]` of the file (each such event lists the route in `dispatched_from`). Filled by the cross-link pass; empty when the controller cannot be resolved.

route.description: HTTP routes, one per route. A route registered against several verbs is reported as `ANY`.

queued.description: `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface.

sent_from.description: Dispatch sites whose resolved kind is `mailable` and whose target is this class, sorted by `file`, `line`. Filled by the cross-link pass.

queued.description: `true` when the class implements `ShouldQueue` directly or through a parent class or interface.

notified_from.description: Dispatch sites whose resolved kind is `notification` and whose target is this class, sorted by `file`, `line`. The only list whose entries may carry `channels`.

channels.description: From a `via()` whose body is a single `return [...]` of literal strings (lowercased: `mail`, `database`, `slack`, ...) or `Class::class` constants (FQCN). Source order. `[]` when `via()` is dynamic or not declared; an inherited `via()` reads as not declared.

channels_dynamic.description: `true` only when `via()` exists but is not a single literal-array return (conditional, property access, variable or keyed items). Channels then exist at runtime but are invisible to static analysis.

expression.description: Pretty-printed source of the unresolvable expression.

reason.description: `dynamic_class_name`: `event($variable)` and similar. `container_resolution`: class fetched from the container (`app()`, `resolve()`, `->make()`). `string_concatenation`: name built by concatenation or interpolation. `conditional_dispatch`: a ternary or conditional whose branches cannot be evaluated.

unresolvedDispatch.description: Dispatch sites whose target could not be resolved statically. Never dropped silently.
